t: How to Buy Commercial Property Without Using Your Own Money - InterNACHI®
s: If you cannot secure a loan to purchase a large property, try buying a piece of it. From there, you can borrow money against that piece in order to purchase the entire lot. This strategy works especially well with raw land, but it can be used in many different situations. Owners may not be aware that this option exists, so be sure to mention it to them, especially when purchasing many acres of land. Before making your commercial real estate purchase, be sure to have the property inspected by a certified InterNACHI inspector.
